implementation.name: original-v4-04-multirate-cadence-buffer
implementation.scope: Two source panels use different scales: mailbox events are ordered, not timed; the upper schedule uses the chapter's milliseconds. A/B payload cells are illustrative identities. The application processor sends frames into MCU-owned memory; no shared AP/MCU storage is implied.
implementation.question: Why can an unchanged mailbox never renew a command lease?

purpose: Animate MCU-local payload publication and rejection before showing an independent lease countdown during proposer stall.
storyboard: Switch to the source stall timeline
guard: Event order and milliseconds are distinct source panels. Even sequence equality validates a copy but does not renew authority. Only admission renews the lease. Fallback onset is not a completed physical stop; no AP/MCU shared memory.
